mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, instance_id, slot_code, str_value, field_code, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM oa_instance_promote WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO oa_instance_promote ( id, tenant_id, instance_id, slot_code, str_value, field_code, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.instanceId}, #{item.slotCode}, #{item.strValue}, #{item.fieldCode}, #{item.createdBy}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedBy}, #{item.updatedAt}, #{item.deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_instance_promote SET slot_code = CONCAT(SUBSTRING(slot_code, 1, 11), '#', id), deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0
